verdict.rationale: Lambda's On-Demand Cloud provides self-serve GPU VMs (B200, H100, GH200). It claims they deploy "in minutes" and can be launched programmatically through the Lambda Cloud REST API, with cloud-init support. Instances come with Lambda Stack, drivers and JupyterLab preinstalled and are reachable over SSH, so code can run right away. Community reports of users launching and SSHing into instances, including a third-party tool built on the API, corroborate the launch flow. Missing for 10: independent evidence of actual time-to-ready in minutes, explicit documentation of the console launch flow (only the Instances page is referenced), and capacity is first-come so availability is not guaranteed.
